description:
Archive a design so it stops showing in the default gallery listing. Reversible with restore_design, and safe: it never touches products that already use the design. This is the right way to retire an unwanted or orphan design. Prefer it over delete_design unless the design must be removed permanently. Find orphan designs first with list_my_designs(on_products=false).

[#16a475]
name: archive_design
